port.name: bottom
port.description: Living Code for bottom: native TOML styles for CPU, memory, network, batteries, graphs, tables and selected widgets.

guide.installation:
```sh
git clone https://github.com/living-code-theme/bottom.git
cd bottom
```

```sh
btm --config "$PWD/themes/living-code-night.toml"
```

To retain your existing monitor layout and process settings, merge the selected file’s `[styles]` tables into your normal `bottom.toml` instead of replacing the whole file.
guide.configuration: The file contains only `[styles]` and its child tables. Remove existing duplicates before merging. Do not pass `--color` when testing the custom palette: a built-in-theme command-line override takes precedence. CPU, temperature and GPU series use a consistent set of Living Code semantic hues. Widget text and selected text use explicit foreground/background pairs.
guide.compatibility: Targets bottom’s current `[styles]` format, verified against its complete upstream valid-style fixture. Older releases using different styling keys are not claimed. Truecolor is recommended. Tests parse TOML, check section/field names against the fixture and verify foreground/selection contrast; they do not claim a real application screenshot.
